question: P, Q, R, S, T and U are six giraffes in a jungle, each with a different height. S is taller than Q. P is taller than R. S is shorter than T. Q is taller than P but shorter than T. T is shorter than U. Which of the six giraffes is the shortest?
solution:
**Given Information:**

Six giraffes: P, Q, R, S, T, U. Each with a different height.

 
• S is taller than Q. (S > Q)
 
• P is taller than R. (P > R)
 
• S is shorter than T. (T > S)
 
• O is taller than P but shorter than T. (T > Q > P)
 
• T is shorter than U. (U > T)

**Combining the relationships:**

​Combining all: U > T > S > Q > P > R

**Determining the shortest giraffe:**

Based on the combined order U > T > S > Q > P > R, the shortest giraffe is R.

**The shortest of the six giraffes is R.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
